verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official, documented MCP server that lets AI assistants query databases, manage migrations, and deploy Edge Functions, confirmed by both docs and a probe hit on the docs page; it also supports building custom MCP servers via Edge Functions and even sets up RLS-based per-user auth for tool calls. Community evidence shows real-world adoption (Cursor + Supabase MCP) though it surfaced a prompt-injection security issue that Supabase acknowledged and partially mitigated — a caveat on safety, not on whether the connection capability works. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the mitigation's effectiveness and broader third-party corroboration beyond one HN thread.
